تحتوشن (form VIII)

# تُحْتَوَشْنَ (tuḥtawašna) /tuħ.ta.waʃ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
